statistical_design.independent_unit: original parent trajectory; siblings/splits/repeated samples are not extra trials
statistical_design.sample_size_method: conservative two-sided Hoeffding planning bound at alpha/K; not an acceptance threshold
statistical_design.stream_contract: must specify original-parent keyed independent streams and demonstrate no clone/MPI stream reuse before execution
statistical_design.confidence: U15 99 percent; I22 95 percent remain distinct; family precision still requires review
statistical_design.rare_branches: complete channel-specific precision/power/censoring design is mandatory; minimum event count alone does not establish precision

numerical_design.policy: freeze budget before outputs; three decreasing errors do not establish a missing budget
numerical_design.horizon_representation: freeze one representable final T, divide by powers of two; use actual represented lambda*T in final statistical design, not assumed exact log(2)
